name: Violeta candies
about: Violet-flavored sugar candies from La Violeta, a Madrid shop that opened in 1915. They are a classic sweet of the city.
tip: Buy a small bag first, since the box sizes are fixed and you can add more later.

name: Vermouth
about: A fortified wine flavored with herbs, popular in Madrid as a pre-lunch drink. Zarro and Zecchini are local brands from the city.
tip: Check that the bottle is sealed and packed well, since glass bottles can break in your luggage.

name: Espadrilles
about: Traditional Spanish canvas shoes with rope soles. This long-running Madrid shop is a good place to find them.
tip: Try them on first, because sizing can run differently from shoes at home.
